name: Lyntris Inc.
summary: Lyntris Inc. is a defense technology company that develops and delivers integrated sensing, data, software, and mission systems for the U.S. and allied defense markets. The company provides “sense-to-act” connectivity solutions that combine sensor architecture, sensor hardware, data fusion, artificial intelligence, command-and-control systems, autonomy, and precision mission capabilities. Its solutions support maritime domain awareness, air and missile defense, and space intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and resilient communications across air, ground, sea, and space environments. Lyntris also provides engineering, manufacturing, systems integration, testing, and lifecycle support, serving mission-critical defense programs from development and prototyping through deployment and sustainment.
